title: Made with an AI-assisted pipeline: VEKARRA, my dark-fantasy party roguelite (local co-op)
author: BorderlineImmigrant
selftext:
I'm Fernando, the solo dev behind VEKARRA, a party-based roguelite with active-time battles where you read enemy telegraphs and break their charges, solo or local co-op on the same couch.

  
How AI fits in: I use generative AI as a production pipeline for assets (code, graphics, sounds and text), and every piece goes through human curation and integration. The concept, design, direction and final cut are mine, and no AI content is generated during gameplay. The clip is real gameplay capture.

  
Happy to answer questions about the workflow and what worked or didn't.

  
Wishlist on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5009280/VEKARRA/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5009280/VEKARRA/)

  
AI disclosure: AI Assisted - Code, Graphics, Sounds, Text.
